bienvenida.util: Understand what your own machine can do, without reading documentation.
bienvenida.hoy: The rack already answers from the web, and the same character can run on your machine.
bienvenida.falta: The artefact does not exist: it must be trained and signed before it can be downloaded.
bienvenida.aportas: Tell us what you expected it to know and it did not. That trains the next version.

medidor.util: Know what your machine really delivers. Vendor figures are not measurements.
medidor.hoy: The measurement table already exists and is read on this very page.
medidor.falta: That the measurement is sent signed and joins an average that shows how many it holds.
medidor.aportas: Measure your machine and keep the result. It is sent when the board opens.

memoria.util: That what you learn lives in a file of yours, on your machine, not in a subscription.
memoria.hoy: The local database exists in the app; this line has no artefact yet.
memoria.falta: Decide which family fits: it asks for long context and images, and that is not Mistral.
memoria.aportas: Tell us what you would like to ask your own history.

reclamaciones.util: Complain without being passed around or told a rule that does not exist.
reclamaciones.hoy: The corpus is written: 200 real cases in two versions, to compare them.
reclamaciones.falta: It is still training, and it must be signed before anyone can download it.
reclamaciones.aportas: Tell us the complaint nobody resolved for you. That is what is missing.
